title: כְּ
content:
[Str1768,1836,2298] כְּ part. like, as, about (BH כְּ, q.v.);—like, as Dn 2:40 תַּקִּיפָא כְּפַרְוְלָא, 4:5, 4:32, 5:1 +; according to 4:32 וּכְּ מִצְבְּיֵהּ עָכֵד and according to his will he doeth, Ezr 6:9, 6:18 +; about (as BH 1 a: cf. Zinj. Lzb444 [ן] כשלשן מלכ), Dn 4:16 כְּשָׁעָה חֲדָה, 6:1; with inf. (BH 3 b), 6:21 וּכְ מִקְרְנֵהּ לִגֻבָּא and as he drew near, etc. Cpds.:—כְּדִי and כִּדְנָה, v. דִּי and כַּחֲדָה; together, v. חַד (sub אחד). p. 453

[Str3538,3576] † [כְּדַב] adj. false (Targum Syr.; v. BH כזב);—fs. abs. מִלָּה כִדְבָה Dn 2:9 ( > n. appos. K175 M66 *).

[Str1768] כְּדִי v. דִּי

title: כָּה
content: [Str3541–42] † כָּה adv. here (BH כֹּה; Targum Mand. כָּא; Chr-Pal. ܟܐ; Syr. with prefixes, as ܠܟܳܐ hither, ܐܰܝܟܳܐ where?);—Dn 7:28 עָד־כָּה סוֺפָא דִי־מִלְּתָא hitherto (cf. Je 48:47, 51:64) is the end of the matter.

title: כְּהַל
content:
[Str3546] † [כְּהַל] vb. be able (Targum id.; Eg. Aram., S-CPap.A 6. 8.11+; Eth. ክህለ፡ cf. syn. יְכִל);—Pe. Pt. act., usu. sq. inf.:abs. כָּהֵל Dn 2:26, 4:15 (inf. om.); pl. abs. כָּֽהֲלִין 5:8, 5:15.

[Str3548–49] † [כָּהֵן] n.m. priest (v. BH כהן);—emph. כָּהֲנָא Ezr 7:12, 7:21; pl. emph. נַיָּא- 6:9, 6:16, 6:18, 7:16, 7:24; sf. (of Isr.) נ֫וֺהִי- v:13.

[Str3551] [כַּוָּה NöGGA 1884. 1019] n.f. window (Targum כַּוְּתָא, Syr. ܟܘܬܐ, cf. SchulthLex. 91 (sub * ܟܘ), hence Ar. كُوّة, كَوّة id., as loan-word Frä13);—pl. abs. כַּ וִּין פְּתִיחָן Dn 6:11 (cf. S-CJ6).

[Str3734] † [כּוֺר] n.[m.] kôr, a measure of wheat (BH כֹּר p. 499);—pl. abs. כּוֺרִין Ezr 7:22.

[Str3566–67] כּ֫וֺרֶשׁ:9 n.pr.m. Cyrus (BH id.);—Dn 6:28, Ezr 5:13 + 6 t. Ezr.

title: כִּכַּר
content: [Str3604,3606] [כִּכַּר], כִּכְּ רִין v. כרר. כֹּל v. כלל–98

title: כְּלַל
content:
[Str3634–35]1097 † [כְּלַל] vb. complete (v. BH I. [כָּלַל]; but ´שַׁכ: perhaps loan-word from As. šuklulu, ušaklil, uštaklil, DIWB 331, cf. שֵׁיוֵב, שֵׁיצֵא and Buhl14);—Shaph. of building: Pf. 3 ms. sf. שַׁכְלְלֵהּ Ezr 5:11 he finished it; 3 mpl. שַׁכְּ לִֹלוּ 6:14, also (c. acc. rei) 4:12 (Kt שׁודי אשׁכללו, read Qr) ´שׁוּרַיָא שׁ:; Inf. לְהַשְׁכְּלָלָה, acc. rei 5:3; 5:9. Ishtaph. be completed, of walls ; Impf. 3 mpl. יִשְׁתַּכְלְלוּן 4:13, 4:16.

[Str3605–06,6903] כֹּל, כָּ־ל: n.m. the whole, all (BH כֹּל);—emph. כֹּלָּא Dn 2:40 +, cstr. כֹּל 2:12, 3:2 +, כָּ־ל 2:8 +, sf. 3 mpl. כָּלְּהוֺן (so Palm. Lzb296 CookeNo. 117, Tariff ii b. 18) † 2:38, 7:19 (Qr f. כָּכְּהֵּן);—1. כֹּל חַכִּימֵי בָבֶכ the whole of ( = all) the wise men of B. 3:2, 3:3, 3:5, etc.; 6:2 כל־מלכותא the whole of the kingdom, v:4; c. sf. the whole of them, 2:38, 7:19. 2. with a sg. noun, understood collectively, every, any, or with a neg. none (BH 1 b):3:29 דִּי כָל־עַם אֻמָּה וְלִשָּׁן that every people, nation, and language, etc., 6:8 מִן־כָּל־אֱלָה of any god, Ezr 6:12 כָּל־מֶלֶח וְעַם; כל אנשׁ די every man who = whoever, Dn 3:10, 5:7, 6:13, Ezr 6:11; Dn 2:10 לא …בל מלך: שׁאל no king hath asked … , v:35, 4:6, 6:5, 6:24; so כָּל־דִּי (= Heb. כָּל־אְִשֶׁר) whoever 6:8, Ezr 7:26, whatever v:23, בְּכָל־דִּי wherever Dn 2:38(cf. אְִשֶׁר 4 b γ). † 3. emph. כֹּלָּא, used absolutely, as Heb. הַכֹּל (BH 2 b):Dn 2:40 חָשֵׁל כֹּלָּא crushing all things, 4:9, 4:18 וּמָזוֺן לְכֹלָּא־בֵהּ and food for all was in it, v:25 כֹּלָּא מְטָא all came upon N. (cf. חַכֹּל בָּא Jos 21:43), Ezr 5:7 שְׁלָמָא כֹלָּא all peace (K§ 83 d; cf. in Heb. כֻּלּוּ etc., after their noun : BH 1 d a).—For כָּל־קְָבֵל v. קְָבֵל

[Str3651–52] † adv. thus, as follows (BH כֵּן; Targum כֵּן, Syr. ܟܢ);—usu. c. אֲמַר (אָמַ, etc.; cf. Eg. Aram. CISii. 149 A 1, B-C 3 REvS492 B 5), Dn 2:24 וְכֵן אֲמַר־לֵהּ, v:25, 4:11, 6:7, 7:5, 7:23, Ezr 5:3; 6:2 וְכֵן־כְּ תִיב בְּגַוַּהּ.

[Str3660] † כְּנֵ֫מָא adv. accordingly, as follows (der. uncertain: NöGGA, 1884, 1021 Marti al. from כֵּן + indef. מָא, so somewhat, ungefähr so: v. older improb. view (as we should say, from כְּ and נֵימָא = נֵאמַר, cf. Talm. יֵימָא for יֵימַר) in Thes652): referring backwards, Ezr 6:13 עֲבַדוּ…כְּנֵמָא: did accordingly; referring forwards, 4:8 … כְּתַבוּ כְנֵמָא wrote a letter … as follows, 5:4(rd. c LXX אֲמַרוּ; אֲמַרְנָא from v:9, MeyEntst. 26), v:9, v:11.

title: כְּנַשׁ
content:
[Str3673,3664] † [כְּנַשׁ] vb. gather (Targum id.; OAram. Palm. בנש Lzb298; Syr. ܟܢܫ; v. also BH [כָּנַס) ;—Pe. Inf, לְמִכְנַשׁ, sq. ל acc. Pers. Dn 3:2. Hithpa. Pt. pl. מִתְכַּנְּשִׁין (were) assembled 3:3, 3:27.

[Str3675] † [כְּנָת] n.m. associate (OAram. id, Lzb298 SAC65; S-CB 6; Syr. ܟܢܬ; Chr-Pal. [ܟܢܐ, ܟܢܬ] SchwallyIdiot. 46 SchulthLex. 93; √ appar. כנח K§ 56, a) β 2 M§ 74 c; Buhl makes loan-wd. from As. kinâtu, ‘Genosse,’ but v. DlWB 338 ZimM.p. 66 *);—associate, pl. sf. כְּבָוָתֵהּ Ezr 5:6, תְהוֺן- 4:9, 4:17, 4:23, 5:3, 6:6, 6:13.

title: כסא
content:
[Str3678] כסא (v. BH כִּסֵּא throne).

[Str3764] † כָּרְסֵא (K§§ 11, 4 b) c); 62) n.m.:Dn 7:9a throne;—cstr. ´כ: Dn 5:20; sf. כָּרְסְיֵהּ 7:9 b; pl. abs. כָּרְסְוָן 7:9 a.

[Str3779] כסדי v. כַּשְדָּי. p. 1098

[Str3702] † כְּסַף n.m.:Ezr 7:17 silver (v. BH);—abs. ´כ: Ezr 7:15 +, כְּסַָף Dn 2:32; emph. כַּסְפָּא v:35 +;—1. as material Dn 2:32, 2:35, 2:45, Ezr 5:14, 6:5. 2. as money or its equivalent Ezr 7:17, v:15, v:16, v:18, v:22.

[Str3705–06] כְּעַן, כְּעֶ֫נֶת, כְּעֶת v. sub ענה.

title: כְּפַחת
content:
[Str3729] † כְּפַחת vb. bind (Targum id.; NH כָּפַת; Syr. ܟܦܬ form knots, ܟܦܬ twist into a knot, Ar. كَفَتَ draw together, As. [kapâtu] II. bring together);—Pe‘îl Pf. 3 mpl. כְּ פִ֫תוּ, (WCG 224) Dn 3:21 they were bound. Pa. bind: Inf. לְכַפָּתָךְ Dn 3:20 (ל acc. Pers.); Pt. pass. pl. מְכַפְּתִין bound v:23, v:24.

[Str3735] † [לְּרָא] vb. Ithpe. be distressed (cf. כַּרְיָא III. adj. suffering, כְּ רִיוּחָא n. id. DWB 197; Syr. ܟܪܐ be short, abridged, ܟܪܝܬ ܠܝ it grieved me; ܟܪܝܘܬܐ pain, grief; cf. As. kûru, pain; also ܟܪܗ (der. spec.) be ill, Ar. كَرِهَ dislike, shrink from);—Pf. 3 ms. אִתְכְּכְּ רִיַת רוּחִי (K§ 47. Beisp. 2) Dn7:15.

[Str3737,3736] † [כַּרְבְּלָא] n.f. prob. helmet, cap (> al. mantle, e.g. K§ 62; v. Dr) (NH כַּרְבָּלָה comb of cock ; so JAram. כַּרְבָּלְתָא, Syr.ܟܰܪܒܳܠܬܳܐ; As. karballatu, cap AndrM 67 *, Muss-ArnAs. Dict. 436 a; so SACJPhii. xxvi. 310 f., cf. BH [כרבל]);—pl. sf. כַּרְבְּלָֽתְהוֺן Dn 3:21.

[Str3744] † [כָּרוֺו] n.m. herald (loan-word from Gk. κήρυξ, κηρύσσειν (K§ 64, 4 Kraussii. 296 f.; NöGGA 1884, 1019 doubts); Targum id., Syr. ܟܪܘܢ (v. Brook), Chr-Pal.[ܟܪܘܢ] SchulthLex. 97; cf. D§ 97 ad fin., also K§ 64, 4 Bev:Dn 5:29 M§ 88);—emph. כָּדוֺוָא Dn 3:4.

[Str3745] † [כְּרַז] vb. denom. Haph. make proclamation (poss. directly dependent on κηρύξ (D§ 37, p. 146 (2nd ed. 183) Kl. c. M67*), but even then formed as denom.; cf. Targum כְּרַו, NH כָּרַז, Syr. ܟܪܐ Af. Ethpe., so Chr-Pal. SchwallyIdiot. 46 SchulthLex. 97);—Pf. 3 mpl. הַכְּ רִ֫צוּ Dn 5:29, c. עַיל Pers. concerning.

[Str3764]1098 כָּרְסֵא v. כסא

title: כרר
content:
[Str3603,3769] כרר (√ of foll.; cf. BH כרר, כִּכָּר 3).

[Str3604] † [כִּכַּר] n.[f.] talent ;—pl.abs. כִּכְּ רִין Ezr 7:22.

[Str3779,3778] † כַּשְדָּי n.pr.gent. Chaldean (v. BH כַשְדִּים);—abs. ´כ: Dn 2:10; emph. כשדיא Dn 5:30 Kt (Qr כַּשְדָּאָה), כסדיא Ezr 5:12 Kt (Qr כַּסְדָּאָה); pl. abs. כַּשְדָּאִין 3:8, 5:11, emph. כשדיא Kt, כַּשְדָּאֵי Qr, Dn 2:5, 2:10, 4:4, 5:7;—1. Chaldean By race Dn 3:8, 5:30, Ezr 5:12. 2. as learned, of the class of Magi (BH ´כ: 1 c), Dn 2:5, 2:10, 2:10, 4:4, 5:7, 5:11.

title: כְּתַב
content:
[Str3789–90] † כְּתַב vb. write (v. BH);—Pe. Pf. 3 ms. ´כ: Dn 6:26 לPers. + orat. rect., 7:1 acc. rei; 3 mpl. כְּתַ֫בוּ Ezr 4:8 acc. אִגְּרָה; 1 pl. נִכְתּוּב5:10, ac. rei; Pt. act. abs. fs. כָּֽתְבָה Dn 5:5, subj. יְדָא, fpl. כָּֽתְבָן v:5, subj. אֶצְבְּעָן. Pe‘îl (WCG 224) Pf. 3 ms. כִּדְנָה כְּ תִּיבEzr 5:7 thus (it) was written, so ´כֵּן כ: 6:2.

[Str3792] † כְּתָב n.m.:Dn 5:7 writing ;— abs. כְּתָב Ezr 7:22 (Baer כְּתַב, but v. K§ 57 ad fin. Str); cstr. ´כ: 6:18; emph. כְּתָבָאDn 5:8 +, הָ֯ 5:7, 5:15;—1. writing, inscription (on wall) Dn 5:7, 5:8, 5:15, 5:16, 5:17, 5:24, 5:25. 2. a. written decree 6:9, 6:10, 6:11. b. written requirement Ezr 6:18, 7:22.

[Str3796–97] † כְּתַל (K§ 54, 3 a) ε) and c) n.[m.] wall (BH כֹּתֶל, √ כתל);—cstr. ´כ: Dn 5:5; pl. emph. כֻּתְלַיָּא Ezr 5:8.
